daemon_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between SMART checks when running as daemon.

logfacility.description: Syslog facility for SMART daemon logs (e.g., LOG_DAEMON, LOG_LOCAL0).

emailaddr.description: Email addresses to which SMART error notifications will be sent.

mailcmd.description: Custom command to send email alerts (e.g., '/usr/local/bin/smartmail.sh').

configdir.description: Directory from which additional per-device configuration files will be loaded.

description.description: Human-readable label for the device (for reference only).

ignore.description: Skip monitoring this device (comment out directive).

ignore_comment.description: Optional reason for ignoring this device (shown as comment).

temperature.description: Temperature mode: 'c' for Celsius (default), 'f' for Fahrenheit, 'm' for millidegrees.

autoinit.description: Auto-initialize device (set to 'off' to disable; 'on' is default).

onoff.description: Enable or disable automatic offline tests ('on' or 'off'); leave empty for default.

healthcheck.description: Enable/disable SMART health status monitoring ('on' or 'off'); default is 'on'.

email.description: Email addresses to receive alerts *for this device only*.

exec.description: Command to execute on SMART error (e.g., '/usr/local/bin/notify.sh').

nosystem.description: Exclude device from system-wide monitoring (rarely needed).

nopowersave.description: Disable power-mode management (use if device wakes on SMART check).

comment.description: Additional notes about this device (shown as comment).

devices.description: List of devices to monitor with their optional per-device settings.
